title: Grateful Dead Live at Cumberland County Civic Center on 1982-09-17

ai_review.summary: An excellent matrix mix captures a scorching 1982 fall show highlighted by a monster The Other One, soaring Morning Dew and a blazing Going Down the Road.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about this tape’s crystal‑clear matrix sound and the band’s high‑octane performance.  The second set is repeatedly called “sweet and spicy,” with The Other One, Morning Dew, Going Down the Road and US Blues singled out as peak moments, while Jerry’s vocals and Phil’s bass are praised throughout.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high star ratings (mostly 4‑5) and enthusiastic comments about both the music and the recording push the combined score well above average.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Multiple reviewers call the matrix mix "awesome," "nice" and "the best recording of this show," noting clear, balanced sound with no reported drop‑outs or muddiness.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Second set described as a sweet‑and‑spicy mix with strong transitions; first set ends intriguingly with Throwing Stones into Deal, leading into an energetic second half.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for sounding great—his vocal tone is noted as both powerful and, at times, pleasantly cracked, adding emotion to songs like Morning Dew.
band_member_comments.Phil: Repeatedly highlighted for a “bass melt down,” heavy low‑end work and overall rocking presence throughout the show.
band_member_comments.Bob: Mentioned mainly for vocals (e.g., on Candyman) and occasional stage banter; no specific criticism or praise of his playing.
band_member_comments.Keys: Even without Brent’s background vocals, keyboard work is described as great and musically crisp, keeping the jam sections tight.
